sentence: In the same panel, AI investment alone stays insignificant while its interaction with R&D turns significantly positive
passage: [Banna & Alam (2025), sec. 4.1] "AI investment alone has a positive but statistically insignificant relationship with revenue growth, while R&D alone shows a negative association." / "the interaction term [ ] exhibits a positive and statistically significant effect, indicating that the combination of AI adoption and R&D activity produces complementary and mutually reinforcing effects on firm performance."

gemini.note: The sentence accurately reflects the reported empirical findings that AI investment alone has an insignificant relationship with revenue growth, while the interaction term with R&D has a statistically significant positive effect.
